queue_order: Stable sorted node IDs within each active round; neighbors enter the next round; node-local gradient steps read the current workspace
budget_scope: All incident-edge reads plus full convergence certificates; input/load/preprocessing work is separately counted and timed
fallback: disabled; exhausted updates leave saved state unchanged
initialization: Exact shared saved C0 geometry compiled from public offsets, certified and saved before every intervention; all setup/load costs charged
controls: Third disconnected component is unaffected; distant connected nodes are potentially affected, never required to remain fixed
reference: Independent sparse anchored least squares (preconditioned conjugate gradients), qualified against independent dense LS at small sizes; compiled coordinates also measured
acceptance: Every result is reference-correct when committed or explicitly unresolved with byte-identical previous state; all budget, reference, retention and reload checks pass
claim_scope: 16 registered structured interventions, one world per size; no uncertainty/generalization or sublinear end-to-end claim
selection_rule: No tuning or adaptive selection; all cases and all unresolved outcomes are retained
